newsitem.title: USA: Felcor buys 50 pct JV interest in 8 hotels.
newsitem.headline: Felcor buys 50 pct JV interest in 8 hotels.

text.p: FelCor Suite Hotels Inc Monday said it will acquire, for about $100 million, about 50 percent joint venture interests in eight Embassy Suites hotels from affiliates of the General Electric Pension Trust, a General Electric Co unit.
Felcor has also has entered into a letter of intent to purchase the full ownership of two additional hotels from affiliates of GEPT and Promus Hotel Corp.
FelCor's $100 million cost includes its $43 million share of existing non-recourse debt. The two wholly-owned hotels will cost an additional $39 million.

The cash portion of the purchase price for these 10 hotels, together with the cost of limited renovations, is expected to be provided primarily from the net proceeds of FelCor's offering of three million shares of common stock, as announced on January 23, 1997.
Promus will continue to own a 50 percent interest in the eight joint venture hotels, which will remain Embassy Suites hotels under management by Promus, Felcor said.
The two wholly-owned hotels are expected to be converted to the Doubletree Guest Suites brand within 90 days following their purchase and will be managed by an affiliate of Doubletree Hotels Corp.
